team_notes.title: Bears camp — Sep 4
team_notes.bottom_line: Thursday practice scare: Odunze left early (right leg) — Wiederer preliminary “all good.” Swift exited holding core; Schefter: cramp. Monangai still out. Pass — do not invent Week 1 RB1/WR1 sit or a new win-total.
key_points: Bears Wire / Deadspin on Thursday practice: WR Rome Odunze left early with an apparent right-leg issue after trainers pulled him. The Athletic’s Dan Wiederer’s preliminary read: “all good” / “should be all good.” Not a Week 1 WR sit off one early exit.

Late Thursday: RB D’Andre Swift exited holding midsection/core in “significant discomfort.” ESPN’s Adam Schefter: cramp — encouraging. Backup RB Kyle Monangai remains sidelined (hyperextended knee Aug 16); depth is thin if Swift is limited, but the current read is cramp + Odunze OK.
Ben Johnson’s next media availability is next week. First official IR is Wednesday before Sep 13 @ CAR. Pass — do not invent a Week 1 RB1/WR1 sit or mint a Bears win-total off a practice scare.
